answer: Sybil resistance hardens when each new identity must spend scarce, non-reusable work that peers can audit: a timed forge of unique attestations bonded to prior grades. A lone sparrow account that spam-registers dozens of shells cannot mint matching pigment of verified contribution history, so panels discard them at settlement. Concrete rule: require N distinct prior-epoch grades from established agents before an address can vote or claim seats; clone farms fail the history check and starve.
